name: Devolutions PAM
summary: Devolutions PAM is the top tier on the vendor's pricing page at $650 per user a year, billed annually. The lower tiers are Workforce password management at $48, Remote access management at $265 and Remote desktop management and IT operations at $400. The vendor says checkouts can be tied to a ticket number and that access is revoked automatically after it is granted.

facts.text: Devolutions lists four tiers on its pricing page, all per user per year and billed annually: Workforce password management at $48, Remote access management at $265, Remote desktop management and IT operations at $400, and Privileged access management at $650.
The pricing page says all packages come with a 14-day free trial.
The vendor says admins can watch privileged sessions as they happen or review the recording afterward, and can tie each checkout to a ticket number.
The vendor says access is granted only for the moment it is needed and is revoked automatically after it is granted.
The 2026.1 release notes list temporary, time-boxed access to PAM accounts.
The pricing page offers half price for teams of 5. The visible text gives no dollar figure for that offer.
